Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, SURYA KANT
Ranbir Penal Code, 1932: s. 497 – Constitutional validity of – Held: The provision u/s. 497 is pari materia provision to s. 497 IPC, which has been declared as unconstitutional in *Joseph Shine case – Therefore, the provision (s. 497 of RPC) is held violative of part III of the on the charges relatable to s. 497 – Appeal allowed – Penal Code, 1860 – s. 497 – Constitution of India – Part III.
